text:
Maya Chen: Quick kickoff — proposing a lightweight "signal harness" we can wire into rollouts. Goal: fast comparative matrix + a few automatic guardrails (latency, cost, errors, golden-set quality). Need runtime + infra inputs (low-cardinality labels, a couple histograms, and a way to surface traces). Asking eng-runtime / infra / platform for constraints and owners.

AJ Rivera: +1. My short list of runtime signals we should expose: request_count, accept_rate, rejection_rate, model_latency_{p50,p95,p99}, batch_size_histogram, kv_cache_hit_ratio, enqueue_time, token_cost_estimate, gpu_util, backend_queue_depth.

Samir Patel: Can we standardize labels? e.g. model, route, rollout_id, variant, region, backend_pool. Important to keep rollout_id low-card (hash or short id). Also attach trace_id/span_id when available for sampled requests.

Maya Chen: Agreed on labels. Example naming + PromQL ideas:
```
# metric names (suggested)
redwood_requests_total{model,route,rollout_id,variant,region}  # counter
redwood_request_rejected_total{...}                         # counter
redwood_latency_seconds_bucket{...}                        # histogram
redwood_batch_size_bucket{...}                             # histogram
redwood_kv_cache_hits_total{...}                           # counter
redwood_token_cost_estimate{...}                           # gauge (per-request estimate)

# simple panels
rate(redwood_requests_total{rollout_id="r123",variant="B"}[1m])
sum(rate(redwood_latency_seconds_bucket{le="0.5"}[5m])) / sum(rate(redwood_requests_total[5m]))  # p50-ish calc via buckets
(rate(redwood_kv_cache_hits_total[5m]) / rate(redwood_requests_total[5m]))
```

AJ Rivera: For alerts we should use conjunctive rules: e.g. if relative increase in p95 > 10% AND traffic > 100rps sustained for 10m -> trigger page. For golden-set quality (see below) absolute + sample count thresholds.

Jess Nguyen: Dashboard UX asks: comparative small-multiples grid (baseline | delta | candidate). Delta column shows percent change + CI. Add a golden-set panel that runs the deterministic prompt set against both variants and shows per-prompt diffs (exact-match, rouge, top-1 accuracy). Need ability to click a cell and open sampled traces/logs. Also heatmap for token_cost vs latency buckets.

Oliver Hart: Ops constraints: avoid high-card labels. Keep rollout_id and variant but avoid per-customer ids on metrics. Retention: metrics 90d ok, but rollout dashboards can be 14d window by default for faster queries. For histograms use Prometheus histograms (le buckets) not summaries for easier aggregations. Consider OTLP -> long-term metrics store for heavy cardinality diagnostics.

Samir Patel: For traces: add span_id on the request metric as an optional label for sampled requests, e.g. sampled_trace_id="<hex>". We'll need a sidecar that can attach trace IDs only for sampled subset so cardinality doesn't explode.

Maya Chen: Concrete asks for eng-runtime (Samir/Oliver): add the following metrics & labels by EOD PR:
```
redwood.requests.total{model,route,rollout_id,variant,region,backend_pool} (counter)
redwood.requests.rejected_total{...} (counter)
redwood.latency_seconds_bucket{...} (histogram with standard buckets)
redwood.batch_size_bucket{model,route,rollout_id} (histogram)
redwood.kv_cache_hits_total{model,route,rollout_id} (counter)
redwood.token_cost_estimate{model,route,rollout_id} (gauge per-request)
# optional, sampled:
redwood.request.trace_id{sampled="true",model,route,rollout_id} (gauge = 1 for sampled requests)
```

canary-bot: Canary r123 for model-x variant=B started at 1773000456, traffic=5% -> 10%.

Jess Nguyen: I'll prototype dashboard panels and a comparison matrix JSON. Want a golden-set runner that hits each variant every 5m and writes results to a small-timeseries (golden_failures_total{prompt_id,variant,rollout_id}).

AJ Rivera: Suggested regression alert for golden set: if (golden_failures_rate_candidate - golden_failures_rate_base) > 0.01 AND candidate_failures >= 20 in last 1h -> create incident ticket.

Oliver Hart: Note on storage: golden_set per-prompt timeseries could explode. Limit to top 200 prompts per-model and use a single aggregated `golden_failures_total` with tags prompt_bucket (hot/cold). We can also sample per-prompt detail to a tracing/obj store for debugging.

Maya Chen: Owners + timeline: eng-runtime (Samir, Oliver) metric PR by EOD; eng-platform (Maya, AJ) dashboard + alert rules draft tomorrow morning; eng-ml (Jess) golden-set harness prototype tomorrow. We'll reconvene in #eng-platform at 11:30 to review.

AJ Rivera: ack :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: quick Q — do we want to include batch queue wait time as separate metric? I can add `redwood.enqueue_seconds_bucket` if people want it.

Maya Chen: Yes please — add enqueue_seconds_bucket. Also add a short doc snippet in the PR describing low-card label strategy and sampling.

AJ Rivera: Awesome, thanks everyone — this should make canary comparisons much less fiddly.
